items.title: Python 3.15 has officially shipped
items.oneliner: Python 3.15 ships UTF-8 by default, frozendict, and more JIT work; the language keeps sanding off production pain.

items.title: Pixel-space image training gets cheaper
items.oneliner: Pyramid-JiT drops the VAE and cuts training samples 11.3x; image generation efficiency just took a meaningful step forward.

items.title: Claude now builds live dashboards
items.oneliner: Anthropic added Dashboards and Motion, pushing Claude from chat assistant toward lightweight BI and presentation generation.

items.title: Telegram Desktop had one-click takeover bug
items.oneliner: Telegram Desktop fixed CVE-2026-107181 in 7.2.9 after crafted links enabled local file theft and account takeover.

items.title: A dead domain became an SEO scam
items.oneliner: en-html.org is reportedly hijacking dead links for backlink fraud; web teams should audit references before scammers rewrite trust.

items.title: The DNS root key roll is imminent
items.oneliner: The DNS root KSK rolls on October 11, and lagging resolvers could break validation if operators missed the trust-anchor update.

items.title: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno
items.oneliner: Cloudflare bought Deno, will sunset runtime development in a year, and gives Deno Deploy users six months to migrate.

items.title: Shopify launched an agent testing sandbox
items.oneliner: ShopGym gives AI shopping agents anonymized stores to practice on, which is exactly the eval infrastructure commerce needed.

items.title: Microsoft open sourced a code sandbox
items.oneliner: Microsoft's MXC packages VMs, containers, and process sandboxes behind one API for running untrusted code safely.

items.title: Oxide raised to feed hardware demand
items.oneliner: Oxide raised $445 million despite profitability, a reminder that hardware winners still need huge balance sheets to ship.
